title: Split-brain partition recovery state machine rollback in distributed leader election
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0236: Split-brain partition recovery state machine rollback in distributed leader election
Repository: `redis/redis`
Category: `Distributed Consensus & Partitioning`
Target File: `consensus/leader_election.py`

#### Problem Description
Quorum intersection failure permits dual leader emergence when partition splits exactly at 50% majority.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Enforce strict odd-node majority check (N/2 + 1) and verify fencing token monotonic increment.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0236.py -q`
expected_invariant: Enforce strict odd-node majority check (N/2 + 1) and verify fencing token monotonic increment.
